text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I rushed the injured Admire Groove to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: That looks like it hurts pretty badly...
That looks like it hurts pretty badly...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I should have moved more carefully...
It was my mistake."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I were to take time off on top of that—
it would be too terrible to bear...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'll just get first aid and head right back.
I have to get back to training—
choice_data_list: I want you to rest and not push yourself for now.
...All right. Let's keep going within reasonable limits.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Even though all the other girls are moving forward..."
choice_data_list: If it gets worse, it'll set you back even further.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...A sound argument.
Understood... I will comply.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: So――please, don't look at me with those eyes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: I'll cover for the delay... so let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Please keep your promise... no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I want to get stronger...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I can still do light
exercise while protecting the injury.
choice_data_list: We'll take it slow and see how it goes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know...
If I'm stopped here, it'll all be for nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll increase the intensity, bit by bit.
Doing everything I can... with all my might...!"
